# Isaac Bigsby Trogdon

> Senior Software Engineer (Enterprise Web Platforms & AI Applications) based in Berlin, Germany. 15+ years building and maintaining production Drupal/PHP platforms for enterprise clients; for the past several years focused on bringing LLMs, Retrieval-Augmented Generation, and vector search into those platforms as maintained production features, not prototypes. Original author and maintainer of three officially released Drupal AI contrib modules.

- Current role: Senior Full-Stack Developer at LOOM GmbH (Berlin), November 2018 to present, AI-focused since 2022.
- Core stack: PHP, Drupal (7–10), Symfony, Python (Flask), LangChain, OpenAI API, React, TypeScript, Qdrant, Milvus, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Docker.
- Daily workflow: Claude Code is the primary development environment for architecture, implementation, refactoring, debugging, and testing.
- Languages: English (native), German (fluent).
- Education: B.A. with Honors, Cultural Studies & German Studies, University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill (1997–2002).

## Open Source

- [AI Assistant UI](https://www.drupal.org/project/ai_assistant_ui): Framework components and UI functionality for AI assistant experiences within Drupal.
- [AI Chatlog](https://www.drupal.org/project/ai_chatlog): Recording, review, and analysis tooling for AI conversations in Drupal.
- [AI Insights](https://www.drupal.org/project/ai_insights): Analytics and insights functionality for AI-powered Drupal applications.
